text: Intel Corporation directly or indirectly holds all of Mobileye Global Inc.'s Class B common stock and 50,000,000 Class A shares, together about 77.1% of Mobileye's outstanding common stock and 96.9% of its voting power as of 27 June 2026.
short: Intel holds about 77.1% of Mobileye and 96.9% of its votes.

source.name: Mobileye Global Inc., Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, Note 1 - General (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Intel Corporation (“Intel” or the “Parent”) directly or indirectly holds all of the Class B common stock of Mobileye as well as 50,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, which as of June 27, 2026, together represent approximately 77.1%
